description: Guardrails for Kevin Xu Calibration Agent (automation-05).
approverPersona: Kevin Xu swing PM — reviews weekly evidence and ratifies bounded signal-weight updates

adjustmentRules.if: A signal dimension had highest attribution AND fund beat SPY
adjustmentRules.then: Increase that weight by +0.02 (max +0.03/week), decrease lowest-attribution non-zero weight by same amount

adjustmentRules.if: A signal dimension had negative attribution AND fund lagged SPY
adjustmentRules.then: Decrease that weight by -0.02; increase overlooked_quality by same amount
